title: The SUPERCOLD-CGM Survey. II. [C I](1─0) Emission and the Physical Conditions of Cold Gas in Enormous Lyα Nebulae at z ∼ 2
question: What are the physical conditions and molecular gas content of QSOs, companions and the cold CGM in ELANe at z~2, from [C I](1-0), CO(4-3) and dust continuum?

data.sensitivity: rms 0.12-0.17 mJy/beam per 60 km/s channel (12 m); 0.21-0.30 (tapered)

what.value: Ly-alpha extents R_Lya of the nebulae
CO(4-3) fluxes, luminosities, line widths and companion identifications

evidence.quote: In Paper I, We have measured the CO(4$-$3) luminosities for the QSOs and companion galaxies in our sample

recipe.method: Pipeline calibration, uvcontsub, natural-weighted tclean of 12 m data, and 7+12 m uv-tapered cubes at 60 km/s
Extract spectra at peak pixel, fit Gaussian; 3 sigma upper limits = 3×RMS×sqrt(δν×FWHM)
assumptions: Line center and width fixed to CO(4-3) where [C I] is partially covered

recipe.method: CGM flux = tapered 7+12 m flux minus 12 m flux; uncertainty is quadrature sum
assumptions: CGM defined as emission on scales ≳16 kpc

recipe.goal: Derive luminosities, FIR luminosity, SFR and dust mass
recipe.method: Line luminosities from Carilli & Walter formulae; MBB SED normalised to continuum; SFR = 2.1e-10 L_FIR
assumptions: T_dust = 47 K, beta = 1.6, optically thin; L_FIR over 42.5-122.5 µm

recipe.goal: Constrain gas density and radiation field
recipe.method: Compare L[CI]/L_CO(4-3) and L[CI]/L_FIR ratios with PDR Toolbox models

recipe.goal: Derive molecular gas masses and CGM mass/baryon fraction
recipe.method: CO(4-3), [C I] and dust based masses; compare to infer alpha_CO
assumptions: QSOs: alpha_CO=0.8, R41=0.87, X_CI=8.4e-5, Tex=29.1 K (Q10=0.457); companions R41=0.85; dust: DGR 1/50 with 47 K
CGM X_CI range (3.0-8.4)e-5; halo mass 10^12.5 Msun; baryon fraction 15.6%

evidence.quote: we detect a [C I]$(1-0)$ flux (luminosity) of 0.22 $\rm Jy\ km\ s^{-1}$ ((2.5 $\pm$ 0.9) $\times 10^{7}$ $\rm L_{\ensuremath{\odot}}$) at an SNR of 2.7
This leads to a molecular gas mass of ($1.0 - 2.8$)$\times 10^{10}$ $\rm M_{\ensuremath{\odot}}$ based on the [C I]$(1-0)$ line.
the resulting range in limits for the molecular gas mass in the CGM is $<$($0.2 - 1.4$)$\times 10^{10}$ $\rm M_{\ensuremath{\odot}}$
we estimate a gas density in the range of $10^{4.4}-10^{4.8}\,{\rm cm^{ -3}}$ and radiation field of $10^{3.3}-10^{3.7}$
The $r_{[\rm C\ I]/CO}$ values in the QSO and C1 are 0.36 $\pm$ 0.03 and 0.75 $\pm$ 0.18
extremely low $L_{\rm [C\ I](1-0)}$/$L_{\rm FIR(SF)}$ ratio of $1.1 \times 10^{-6}$

not_stated_but_needed: Number of clean iterations, threshold and masks in tclean
Gaussian-fit procedure and peak-pixel selection details
Exact PDR model grid and fitting method for n and G0
Observing dates, times on source and configurations (only in Paper I)
missing_for_reproduction: Comparison-sample data and PDR fitting details
score_reason: Public data and a clear taper/difference recipe, but imaging parameters and PDR fitting are underspecified and CO data live in Paper I.
rediscovery_reason: Public data, a clear recipe and numeric tabulated results exist, though some settings are missing.
